title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
description:
Write `double celsiusToFahrenheit(double celsius)`.

The formula is: fahrenheit = celsius × 9 / 5 + 32

```cpp
celsiusToFahrenheit(100.0)   // 212.0
celsiusToFahrenheit(0.0)     // 32.0
```
hints: Write `9.0 / 5.0`, not `9 / 5`. With whole numbers, `9 / 5` is `1`.
